title: Von Braun captured in Bavaria under Operation Paperclip

tellings.quote: He was captured in Bavaria, where a young Henry Kissinger was actually helping run counterintelligence for the United States. von Braun's record was scrubbed,

plain: The German rocket engineer Wernher von Braun was captured in Bavaria in 1945, where a young Henry Kissinger was helping run US counterintelligence, and his record was then "scrubbed" so he could be brought to America under Operation Paperclip, the US programme that recruited German scientists after the war. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about NASA and UFOs. The point he draws is that NASA's founding figures came to the US with their pasts cleaned up.
